{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, ensure all revenue strings are properly formatted
print("Original revenue sample:", df['revenue'].head())

df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print("Revenues after cleaning (first 5):", df['revenue_clean'].head())

# Confirm no QA orders are present (they were supposed to be 999999.99)
qa_check = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"QA orders found after cleaning: {len(qa_check)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}")"}
